name: JoinDataTablesNode
label: Join Data Tables
description: Joins two data tables based on the specified join rule.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: FirstDataTable
fields.label: First Data Table
fields.description: The first DataTable to be joined.

fields.name: SecondDataTable
fields.label: Second Data Table
fields.description: The second DataTable to be joined.

fields.name: JoinOperation
fields.label: Join Operation
fields.description: Specifies the type of join operation (Inner, Left, Full).

selectOptions.label: Inner Join
selectOptions.description: Returns only rows that have matching values in both tables.

selectOptions.label: Left Join
selectOptions.description: Returns all rows from the first table, and matching rows from the second table.

selectOptions.label: Full Join
selectOptions.description: Returns all rows from both tables, matching where possible.

fields.name: JoinedDataTable
fields.label: Joined Data Table
fields.description: The resulting DataTable after performing the join operation.
